rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr identifies Sūrat al-ʿAlaq as the first revelation from the Qur'an.
rows.anchor: تفسير سورة اقرأ وهي أول شيء نزل من القرآن

rows.speaker: عائشة
rows.claim: ʿĀʾisha reports that true dreams began revelation, then the Prophet loved solitude, worshiped at Ḥirāʾ for several nights, and Khadīja supplied his provisions.
rows.anchor: عن عائشة قالت : أول ما بدئ به رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من الوحي الرؤيا الصادقة في النوم

rows.speaker: عائشة
rows.claim: ʿĀʾisha recounts Gabriel's three forceful embraces in the cave, Muhammad's repeated reply that he could not read, and Gabriel's recitation of the opening revelation; Muhammad returned trembling.
rows.anchor: فجاءه الملك فيه فقال : اقرأ . قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: خديجة
rows.claim: In ʿĀʾisha's report, Khadīja reassures Muhammad that God will never disgrace him, citing his kinship ties, truthfulness, bearing burdens, hospitality, and help in adversity.
rows.anchor: يا خديجة ، ما لي : فأخبرها الخبر وقال : " قد خشيت علي " . فقالت له : كلا أبشر فوالله لا يخزيك الله أبدا ؛ إنك لتصل الرحم

rows.speaker: ورقة بن نوفل
rows.claim: Waraqa ibn Nawfal, Khadīja's relative, was a pre-Islamic Christian who wrote Arabic and Gospel material in it; he identified the angel as the messenger sent to Moses, predicted opposition and expulsion, and promised support if alive.
rows.anchor: فقال ورقة : هذا الناموس الذي أنزل على موسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr adds, with the qualifier “as has reached us,” that after Waraqa's death revelation paused and grief brought Muhammad repeatedly to mountain peaks, where Gabriel reassured him he was truly God's messenger.
rows.anchor: وفَتَر الوحي فترة حتى حَزن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم - فيما بلغنا -

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr says the report is transmitted in both Ṣaḥīḥs through al-Zuhrī; he notes that he examined its chain, text, and meanings in his Bukhārī commentary.
rows.anchor: وهذا الحديث مخرج في الصحيحين من حديث الزهري

rows.speaker: author

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person becomes joyful, insolent, boastful, and transgressive when he sees himself as self-sufficient and his wealth has increased.
rows.anchor: يخبر تعالى عن الإنسان أنه ذو فرح وأشر وبطر وطغيان ، إذا رأى نفسه قد استغنى وكثر ماله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person becomes joyful, insolent, boastful, and transgressive when he sees himself as self-sufficient and his wealth has increased.
rows.anchor: يخبر تعالى عن الإنسان أنه ذو فرح وأشر وبطر وطغيان ، إذا رأى نفسه قد استغنى وكثر ماله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr warns that all return to God, who will reckon with a person about where his wealth came from and how he spent it.
rows.anchor: وسيحاسبك على مالك : من أين جمعته ؟ وفيم صرفته

rows.speaker: عبد الله
rows.claim: ʿAbd Allāh says worldly and knowledge seekers are both insatiable but unequal: the learned gain God's approval, while the worldly person persists in transgression; he connects 96:6–7 with 35:28.
rows.anchor: عن عون قال : قال عبد الله : مَنهومان لا يشبعان

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr says the maxim was also transmitted as a Prophetic report: two insatiable seekers are the seeker of knowledge and the seeker of worldly gain.
rows.anchor: وقد رُوي هذا مرفوعًا إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr says the passage was revealed about Abū Jahl, who threatened the Prophet for praying at the House.
rows.anchor: نزلت في أبي جهل ، لعنه الله ، توعد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God first admonishes the forbidding man in the gentlest manner.
rows.anchor: فوعظه الله تعالى بالتي هي أحسن أولا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The man being restrained may be rightly guided in conduct or command piety in speech, while Abū Jahl threatens him for praying.
rows.anchor: أي : فما ظنك إن كان هذا الذي تنهاه على الطريق المستقيمة في فعله ، أو { أَمَرَ بِالتَّقْوَى } بقوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The forbidding man ought to know that God sees him, hears his speech, and will recompense his deed fully.
rows.anchor: أي : أما علم هذا الناهي لهذا المهتدي أن الله يراه ويسمع كلامه ، وسيجازيه على فعله أتم الجزاء
